caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with ornate features, positioned at an angle where its right side is more visible. The chair frame, including the legs, armrests, and back support, is light brown with greenish hues and visible wood grain and detailing. The armrests have a carved scroll design at the front. The chair has a rectangular seat and a trapezoidal backrest, both of which are upholstered in a dark brown material, possibly leather, and decorated with visible metal studs along the edge. The legs are straight and connected by four stretchers, with the front and side stretchers having a twisted, spindle-like design. The background is a plain off-white, and the chair is drawn within a thin, single-lined rectangle centered on the page. In the lower right corner, the name "Cordena Jackson" is written in small letters.
title: Sacramental Chair
